newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA must cut Australia rates again - ACCI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA must cut Australia rates again - ACCI.

text.p: The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI), one of Australia's largest business lobby groups, said the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) must aim for higher economic growth and cut official interest rates again.
"There is no alternative to faster rates of economic growth if unemployment is to be brought down," the ACCI said.
"To maintain a faster rate of growth, interest rates must come down further and remain low," it said.
The RBA had been cautious in cutting official cash interest rates by only half a percentage point to 6.5 percent last Wednesday, it said.

The ACCI said it believed growth had not been as strong as that shown in the annual accounts and a measurement using the Consumer Price Index rather than consumption deflator gave a final private demand growth rate of 2.5 percent.
"The economy last year was more like a two and a half percent economy rather than one bursting along at four-plus percent."
